claims: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) will observe 10 holidays in 2026.
Most holidays observed by the New York Stock Exchange in 2026 fall on Mondays or Fridays.
The NYSE New Year's Day holiday closure is on Thursday, January 1, 2026.
The NYSE Martin Luther King, Jr. Day holiday closure is on Monday, January 19, 2026.
The NYSE Presidents' Day holiday closure is on Monday, February 16, 2026.
The NYSE Good Friday holiday closure is on Friday, April 3, 2026.
The NYSE Memorial Day holiday closure is on Monday, May 25, 2026.
The NYSE Juneteenth holiday closure is on Friday, June 19, 2026.
The NYSE Independence Day holiday closure is on Friday, July 3, 2026 (observed).
The NYSE Labor Day holiday closure is on Monday, September 7, 2026.
The NYSE Thanksgiving Day holiday closure is on Thursday, November 26, 2026.
The NYSE Christmas Day holiday closure is on Friday, December 25, 2026.
The NYSE has an early closure at 1:00 PM ET on Friday, November 27, 2026 (Day after Thanksgiving).
The NYSE has an early closure at 1:00 PM ET on Thursday, December 24, 2026 (Christmas Eve).
